input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 obliges Vendor (Cobalt) to carry insurance at its own expense for the term plus one year at limits that match our preferred position in full: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, plus workers' compensation as required by law (and employer's liability USD 1M as a bonus). Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable/primary insurers, cancellation notice and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liability. No redline needed; this exceeds rather than sits at the fallback.
